## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how this change addresses it. Link the relevant issue.

## Scope

List the public files/surfaces changed. Explain any effect on SDK behavior,
compatibility, dependencies or documentation claims. W2-v1 and published 0.1.0
artifacts are immutable; changes outside the current public roadmap need review.

## Validation

State what was actually run and the result. For examples/docs, identify whether
you used the released `saxil-core==0.1.0` wheel or a source checkout. Include
reproduction commands or CI links and any remaining limitation.

## Contributor checks

- [ ] Commits include the DCO sign-off required by CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Public claims and examples match supported SDK behavior.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or failures/untested parts are explained above.

For suspected vulnerabilities, use SECURITY.md's private channel before opening
a public PR with technical details. Do not include credentials or private data.
